release.content: pubkit 0.37.0 was released on 2026-11-12 from commit 1f6e250a5353a6a68b719d45377a1d47a5063aa9 with these changes.

rows: The Gherkin suite runs on every core: pubkit's own make functional and a Rust crate's pubkit.mk run pytest with -n auto (pytest-xdist, which the shared tests requirements already pin) by default, coverage combining the workers' data as before; PYTEST_ARGS= in the Makefile runs it on one core

A Python package's make targets are pubkit's: sync manages pubkit-python.mk (venv, functional, lock, sync-check, wheel, clean, help; the suite on every core, PYTEST_ARGS ?= -n auto, its coverage combined into coverage/coverage.xml; FUNCTIONAL_ENV and EDITABLE for what differs) and seeds a Makefile that includes it, and sync --check fails until the Makefile includes it and pyproject.toml's [tool.coverage.run] sets patch = ["subprocess"] and parallel = true
